summary: Dispatched with a single scope: continue Phase 5 (suppression audit) with the full budget, per the RESUME HERE section's worklist and all recorded safety lessons. Processed 4 more local-only files to zero blanket suppressions each, all confirmed local-only via `git cat-file -e upstream/main:<path>` before editing, each rebuilt individually plus its downstream importers, each committed separately: `Temporal/Metalogic/Chronicle/PointInsertion/Splitting.lean` (5 -> 0, 765 lines: style.emptyLine/style.setOption vestigial, 1 unusedSimpArgs site fixed mechanically, ~48 style.longLine sites fixed mechanically, 4 flexible declarations narrowed to declaration-scoped set_option lines, commit 8bb8f6e5), `Temporal/Metalogic/Chronicle/PointInsertion/Burgess.lean` (5 -> 0, 870 lines: same vestigial categories, 2 unusedSimpArgs sites fixed, ~40 longLine sites fixed, 6 flexible declarations narrowed, commit 6771ddeb), `Bimodal/Metalogic/BXCanonical/Chronicle/PointInsertion/Burgess.lean` (5 -> 0, 987 lines, structurally near-identical listConj/neg_mem_of_inconsistent_union helper family to the Temporal Burgess.lean processed the same cycle: 2 unusedSimpArgs sites fixed, ~20 longLine sites fixed, 5 flexible declarations narrowed, commit b54360e8), `Bimodal/Metalogic/Decidability/CountermodelExtraction.lean` (5 -> 0, 1088 lines, a different category mix -- unusedSectionVars/unusedSimpArgs/flexible/longLine/setOption, no emptyLine: 1 unusedSectionVars site narrowed with set_option rather than omit per the statement-preserving constraint, 6 unusedSimpArgs sites fixed, ~18 longLine sites fixed, 5 flexible declarations narrowed, commit 78b7b88a). Suppression-audit progress: 193 -> 213 sites audited cumulative (33 files fully processed). Ratchet re-baselined in each file's own commit (248 -> 228 blanket suppressions repo-wide; 214 local-only in-scope remaining per a live re-count). Plan's Phase 5 section updated with a cycle-15 entry documenting all four files, two new findings (an Edit-tool false-duplicate-match lesson, and a note on the two structurally-similar Burgess.lean files), and a refreshed worst-offender list / resume point (commit c311471a). Full CSLib CI pipeline re-run at cycle end and confirmed green: lake build --wfail --iofail exactly 5 baseline sorry warnings (zero new), checkInitImports clean, lint-style clean, mk_all no update necessary, lake test exit 0. Phase 7's two prior-cycle blockers were explicitly NOT re-investigated per the delegation instruction and are carried forward unchanged below, as instructed. One new out-of-scope finding was flagged (not fixed): lake shake reports import-minimization drift across ~15 files, none touched by this or any prior Phase 5 cycle -- recorded in the plan for a future dedicated pass.
blockers: CARRIED FORWARD unchanged from prior cycles, NOT re-investigated per explicit delegation instruction -- Phase 7 item 1 (NOTATION.md logic-notation-scoping section) cannot be completed as a local hygiene edit: NOTATION.md is confirmed byte-identical to upstream/main. A human decision is needed on whether to (a) route this as a small upstream PR (recommended), or (b) explicitly authorize editing this specific shared docs file locally as an exception to the carve-out.

CARRIED FORWARD unchanged from prior cycles, NOT re-investigated per explicit delegation instruction -- Phase 7 item 2 (5 NOTE: block deletions) was deliberately NOT executed as literally instructed in an earlier cycle, because investigation found the premise ('stale') false. Still flagged for explicit user sign-off on that judgment call.
decisions_made: Prioritized the smallest remaining count-5-tier files first (Splitting.lean at 765 lines, then Burgess.lean at 870, then the Bimodal Burgess.lean at 987, then CountermodelExtraction.lean at 1088), per the established cycle-7/8/9 finding that per-declaration narrowing effort scales with file size more than raw suppression count.

For all four files, used declaration-scoped set_option linter.flexible false in rather than attempting simp?-verified rewrites for every flexible site, per the cycle-9/11 precedent that flexible rewrites often exceed the sanctioned mechanical edit set for a hygiene-only task and the cycle-11 finding that the linter's own Try-this suggestions are not always trustworthy without a rebuild.

For CountermodelExtraction.lean's single unusedSectionVars site, used set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false in rather than omit [...] in, per the established statement-preserving constraint from cycle 6.

Placed every new set_option ... in line before its declaration's doc comment (never between), per the cycle-12 parse-hazard finding, and verified via rebuild after each declaration-scoped suppression per the cycle-14 declaration-mapping-verification lesson -- no mapping errors this cycle.

When an Edit call unexpectedly reported 2 matches for a 2-space-indented old_string that grep -F found only once, did not assume the extra match was a true duplicate -- investigated with cat -A, found the second site was the same text at 4-space indent in a different declaration, and targeted each occurrence individually with surrounding context instead of using replace_all.
Did not re-investigate Phase 7's two carried-forward blockers, per the explicit delegation instruction that they are settled and awaiting a human decision, not further investigation.

Did not fix the lake shake import-minimization drift discovered during final CI verification, since none of the affected files have any suppression-audit connection and fixing them would exceed this dispatch's Phase-5-only scope -- flagged in the plan instead, following the same 'record, don't silently fix or ignore' discipline the cycle-12/13 wfail regression established.
dead_ends: None this dispatch. All four files' flexible/unusedSimpArgs/unusedSectionVars sites resolved cleanly using the established Phase 5 method with no mid-pass corrections needed.
